name: jina-embeddings-v5-text (small 677M, nano 239M)

lineage.how_derived: distillation from Qwen3-Embedding-4B plus task-specific contrastive losses; adapters merged

purpose: Multilingual text embeddings for retrieval, matching, clustering and classification.

license.name: CC BY-NC 4.0
license.notes: Card section 'License' read: 'jina-embeddings-v5-text-small is licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0. For commercial use, please contact us' (the vendor's sales). Tag and text agree. Standard CC BY-NC 4.0 text itself not fetched. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.why_this_design: Distillation from a 4B teacher; robust under truncation and binary quantization; adapters merged into base weights for vLLM/TEI/ONNX compatibility (card). 1024-d, MRL 32..1024.

engine_support.notes: A news report says llama.cpp and MLX work (secondary); no GGUF named on the card.

strengths: MMTEB 67.7 at 0.68B versus 64.33 for Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (vendor numbers, protocols may differ)

tona_fit.reason: Strong small multilingual embedder (0.68B, vendor MMTEB 67.7, MTEB English v2 71.7), fits every class. Compare with Qwen3-Embedding (MMTEB 70.58 at 8B) on our own retrieval before choosing the default.

open_questions: Is the MMTEB number comparable to Qwen's MTEB multilingual v2 mean?
